title: Tesla Stock News (Oct 19, 2026): TSLA Falls 2.1% to $354.72
summary: Tesla (TSLA) closed at $354.72 on Oct 16, down 2.13%, in line with a 2.15% Nasdaq drop, as investors await Q3 results due October 21.
body_markdown:
At $354.72, the stock sits 28.89% below its 52-week high of $498.83 and 19.28% above its 52-week low of $297.38.


## Why Tesla Stock Fell


None of the sources reviewed for this article named a Tesla-specific trigger for Friday's decline. The drop came on a day when the Nasdaq lost 2.15% and most large technology and chip stocks closed lower, so the move reads as part of that wider sell-off rather than a reaction to company news.


Attention is now on the earnings report. According to[Tesla's official third-quarter production and deliveries release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001318605/000162828026064366/exhibit991111111.htm) , the company will post its results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, followed by a webcast at 5:30 p.m.


Eastern Time. As reported by[BeInCrypto](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/top-4-earnings-reports-week-230000021.html) , the key question for Tesla is "whether margins recover," with analysts tracked by Nasdaq expecting $0.21 per share, down from $0.37 a year earlier.


Spending is a second theme. Per[Barchart](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/elon-musk-admits-no-idea-173002889.html) , Elon Musk said on October 10 that Tesla and SpaceX would build and run the Terafab chip complex themselves, and neither company has said how it will split the costs.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Tesla's release shows the company delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter against production of 464,391, and BeInCrypto reported that the delivery total beat forecasts.
- The same release shows 13.7 GWh of energy storage deployed in the quarter, keeping the energy business a second source of activity beside cars.
- Friday's drop was in line with the Nasdaq rather than worse than it, which points to market-wide pressure rather than a Tesla-specific setback.


### Risks


- BeInCrypto noted that in July Tesla earned $0.33 per share against a $0.55 estimate as margins slipped, so margins remain the main test of the October 21 report. Readers following the release can use a guide on[how to read an earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) .
- According to Barchart, the first phase of Terafab in Grimes County, Texas, is set to cost about $16.8 billion and the full project could reach $119 billion, a concern given Tesla's negative free cash flow in the second quarter.
- Barchart also reported that Tesla's stock is down about 19% so far this year.
